object_description: four-storey plinth-based building with buried wing
design_condition: The building accompanies the main street while the buried transverse gymnasium creates a low setting toward the planned park and separates public open space from the school grounds.

positive.statement: The composition clearly separates the public open space from the school grounds.

position.target: public open space and school grounds
position.rationale: The top view clearly separates the open western area from the denser school building mass.

positive.statement: The building has an appropriate architectural expression, and the timber cladding is not too prominent in this location.

position.rationale: Cladding is not identifiable in point samples; the marker uses the prominent north-facing building façade.

positive.statement: The two visible entrances provide a clear address from the city.

position.rationale: Entrance locations are approximated at the lower building edge facing the city-side open approach.

positive.statement: The two-storey stairwells are well lit, well proportioned, and clearly laid out.

position.rationale: Two narrow vertical circulation features are visibly incised within the main building mass.

positive.statement: The clearly laid out and efficient system requires only one elevator.

position.rationale: The elevator is not distinguishable; the marker approximates the main internal circulation zone.

positive.statement: The simple system allows for great planning and operational flexibility.

position.rationale: Planning flexibility and operation concern the overall system, without a discrete spatial referent.

positive.statement: The plausible basic structure can be expected to have medium construction costs.

position.rationale: The linear plinth-based structure and transverse wing are legible across the rendered building envelope.

negative.statement: Because the facility occupies the entire perimeter, extending it would require adding a storey to the gymnasium and replacing the kindergarten outdoor space.

position.target: gymnasium extension and kindergarten outdoor space
position.rationale: The open western site area is the plausible kindergarten outdoor zone affected by future gymnasium expansion.

negative.statement: The project is well developed but the spatial structure remains too schematic.

position.rationale: The visible linear mass and limited incisions support the critique of a schematic overall structure.

negative.statement: The canteen and multi-purpose room are not connected to the entrance hall as one coherent spatial unit.

position.rationale: Interior rooms are not visible; the estimate uses the lower entrance-side portion of the building.
